'''Michael Blythe''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II Constructed (5 May, 3 pm)]] on 5 May 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court (started Scum)]], according to Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d704">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapoconii-5-5-00d704/ ramapoconii-5-5-00], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapoconii-5-5-00d704/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
